rules.build: cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make HOSTSYSTEM="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ PREFIX="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ PLATFORM=linux \ C_COMPILER_OPTIMIZATION_OPTIONS="$CFLAGS $CPPFLAGS" \ VARDIR=/var/lib/
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make HOSTSYSTEM="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ PREFIX="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ PLATFORM=linux \ LINKER_LINK_SHARED_DLOADABLE_OPTIONS="-L. -shared $LDFLAGS" \ LINKER_LINK_SHARED_PROGRAM_OPTIONS="$LDFLAGS" \ LIBCHICKEN_SO_LINKER_OPTIONS="$LDFLAGS -Wl,-soname,libchicken.so.11" \ VARDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/var/lib" install
rm -fr $AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/chicken/doc
